title: 第1352章 真正的宝藏第1351章 寻到遗迹
lines: 咣当……
一声巨响，振聋发聩，南天门直接打开。
靠！
早知道这么简单先前还费那事，他们都快被累趴下了。
南天门打开，高山向里边望去可惜什么都见不到，因为完全被氤氲之气笼罩着。
高山迈步向里走去，其余人也紧随跟上。
待他们进入，南天门又咣的关闭，将所有人吓了一跳。
“置身这里感觉好舒服啊，只是这里残破了些。”唐芊芊感叹道。
四周都是残垣断壁，明显有打斗的痕迹。
潘老爷子感叹道:“那一战太惨烈了，天庭都打碎掉了，能留下这遗迹也不错了，这遗迹内有不少残存仙力，估计这就是留下的最大宝藏了，能够改善你们体质，有助于你们提升。”
高山点头道:“只是刚一进来就感觉有要突破迹象了，在这里修炼的确会事半功倍。”
他准备回头去把医门人都接来，做最后备战。
“你们先原地修炼，我再往里走走。”越往里走越能感受到那一战的惨烈。
那一战打的整个天庭几乎都面目全非了。
接下来的一战不会有这么惨烈，但也一定会轰轰烈烈。
史前，天庭群雄惨胜打跑了外来入侵者。
但这里的传承也断掉了，所以天道为保护华夏设置了空间壁垒。
可天道知道这不是长久之计，所以选择了一个传承人，担负起对抗外来入侵者的大业。
这个人就是自己。
高山一步步走着，感觉一切渐渐都明晰了。
他传承的是救人的医学，但也肩负着救世的职责。
他要救的不是几个患者，而是整个华夏。
他传承的是医学，同时也是这些天庭英豪的精神。
高山一步步走去，越来越明悟，心境也越来越豁达。
不知不觉间，他竟然突破了，达到了守丹高阶，离着孕婴只有一步之遥，不过他还需要踏实境界，不能急于突破。
高山深呼一口气。
潘老爷子说这里的残存仙气就是最大的宝藏，实则不然。
在高山看来，这断壁残垣才是真的宝藏，是史前英杰们留下的巨大财富。
这股无畏无惧的精神会激励着所有华夏人，所有医门人砥砺前行。
高山露出会心的微笑，不论结果如何，不论最终能否守住华夏，他不会负了这些英豪的威名。
当然，他也会尽力完成先辈们的壮举，纵死不辞。
高山停下脚步，突然感觉前方有金光闪耀。他走进看了看，没想到竟然有金灵石在这里诞生了。
根据南宫梦介绍，金灵石是最稀缺的属性灵石，不过金属性主攻，霸道的一匹。
高山尝试着吸收金灵石的金属性灵气，初吸收感觉身体像是被无数刀割片肉似的，过了好一阵才渐渐好转。
content_en:
Bang...
There was a loud noise, deafening, and the Nantian Gate opened directly.
Depend on!
If they had known it was so easy, they would have almost collapsed from exhaustion if they had bothered to do that before.
The Nantian Gate opened, and Gao Shan looked inside but could not see anything, because it was completely enveloped by the mist.
Gao Shan stepped inside, and the others followed closely.
When they entered, the Nantian Gate slammed shut again, startling everyone.
"It feels so comfortable here, but it's a little dilapidated." Tang Qianqian sighed.
There are ruins all around, and there are obvious signs of fighting.
Mr. Pan sighed: "That battle was so tragic that the heaven was shattered. It's good to leave this relic behind. There is a lot of residual immortal power in this relic. I guess this is the biggest treasure left. It can improve your physique and help you improve."
Gao Shan nodded and said: "As soon as I came in, I felt there were signs of a breakthrough. Practicing here will indeed get twice the result with half the effort."
He was going to go back and fetch all the medical staff to make final preparations for the war.
"You guys practice in place first, and I'll walk inside again." The further inside you go, the more brutal the battle can be felt.
That battle almost changed the entire heaven beyond recognition.
The next battle won't be so tragic, but it will definitely be vigorous.
In prehistoric times, the heroes of heaven defeated the foreign invaders in a tragic victory.
But the inheritance here was also broken, so Tiandao set up space barriers to protect China.
But Tiandao knew that this was not a long-term solution, so he chose a successor to take on the great cause of fighting against foreign invaders.
This person is myself.
As Gaoshan walked step by step, everything gradually became clearer.
He inherited the medicine of saving lives, but he also shouldered the responsibility of saving the world.
What he wants to save is not just a few patients, but the entire China.
What he inherited was medicine, but also the spirit of these heavenly heroes.
As I walked up the mountain step by step, I became more and more enlightened and my state of mind became more and more open-minded.
Unknowingly, he broke through and reached the high level of Dan Shou, only one step away from being pregnant with a baby. However, he still needed to be grounded and could not rush to break through.
Gao Shan took a deep breath.
Mr. Pan said that the remaining immortal energy here is the greatest treasure, but this is not the case.
In Gao Shan's view, these ruins are the real treasures and the huge wealth left by the prehistoric heroes.
This fearless spirit will inspire all Chinese people and all medical practitioners to move forward.
Gao Shan showed a knowing smile. No matter what the outcome was, no matter whether he could defend China in the end, he would not let down the reputation of these heroes.
Of course, he will try his best to complete the feats of his ancestors and even risk death.
Gao Shan stopped and suddenly felt a golden light shining in front of him. He walked in and took a look, but he didn't expect that a golden spirit stone was born here.
According to Nangong Meng, the golden spirit stone is the rarest attribute spirit stone, but the metal property is the main attack and domineering one.
Gao Shan tried to absorb the metallic aura of the Golden Spirit Stone. At first, he felt like his body was being cut into pieces by countless knives. It took a while before he gradually got better.
title_en: Chapter 1352 The Real Treasure Chapter 1351 Found the Relics
